description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2510017276376 HOOD,ENGINE COMPART: Line 0001 Qty 6 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0069 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
